It shall be unlawful to perform the duties and responsibilities of a construction superintendent, as specified in chapter 33 of the New York city building code, unless such work is performed by a person licensed as a construction superintendent under the provisions of this article and department rules.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
